svg.title: Signal Sleuth and Cerberus data paths
svg.desc: Signal Sleuth combines radio observations and GNSS in survey logs. Cerberus sends C5 observations to S3 and can save data to microSD. The USB installer report is a separate browser download.

g.text: ESP32 + BW16 + GNSS → survey record → SPI microSD → workstation copy
C5 radio → S3 controller → microSD → workstation copy
USB installer → browser diagnostics → separate report download
